title: Handy
text: Handy. These are AWESOME to use for packing and traveling.  The perfect size for lots of stuff, but I mostly use for/with packing.  I use with wet swimsuits too.  To me, they are worth every penny.  The arrived quickly and in good condition (I have Prime).  I keep them on hand and will continue to do so.
